HED.prologue: testconflict 1.1.2 is unpartnered. Change from 1.1.0: revises the description of Object-tag (patch bump: description revision). Version 1.1.1 was deliberately never released, showing that version strings need not be dense.

node.name: Object-tag
node.description: An ordinary hierarchy of items used for annotations in schema load tests.

node.name: Measure-tag
node.description: A tag that takes a measurement value in load tests.

node.name: Legacy-tag
node.description: An obsolete tag present only in the 1.x versions of testconflict.

node.name: Shared-item
node.description: An item identical in every library that shares it.

node.name: Attribute-item
node.description: An item whose suggestedTag value is the controlled difference between libraries.

node.name: Description-item
node.description: An item whose description text is the controlled difference between libraries. This is the testconflict wording.

node.name: Nested-item
node.description: An item whose position in the hierarchy is the controlled difference between libraries.

node.name: Placeholder-item
node.description: An item whose placeholder child presence is the controlled difference between libraries.

schemaAttributeDefinition.name: suggestedTag
schemaAttributeDefinition.description: A schema attribute that indicates another tag that is often associated with this tag. This attribute is used by tagging tools to provide tagging suggestions.

schemaAttributeDefinition.name: takesValue
schemaAttributeDefinition.description: A schema attribute indicating the tag is a hashtag placeholder that is expected to be replaced with a user-defined value.

propertyDefinition.name: boolProperty
propertyDefinition.description: Indicates that the schema attribute represents something that is either true or false and does not have a value. Attributes without this value are assumed to have string values.

HED.epilogue: Part of the hed-tests test schema set. See json_test_data/test_schemas/README.md for the loading convention.
